data.action: 手持折扇侧身回眸，夜空烟花璀璨，浴衣下摆微扬，神情柔和含蓄
data.camera: medium shot, low angle looking up, dramatic sky view
data.description: 【星见雅 · 夏夜花火与深蓝浴衣】临海神社石阶的高台上，夜空绽放出一朵璀璨耀眼的千轮金色花火。雅身穿月夜深蓝暗纹浴衣，系着深红腰带，手持一柄精巧的折扇侧身回眸。盛大花火的光华映照在她清秀绝俗的面庞上，金色的狐瞳中罕见地流露出一丝少女特有的柔软微光。
data.lighting: 漫天花火爆开的金色、绯红多重光晕映照脸庞与发丝
data.location: 神社鸟居石阶高台观景处
data.promptProse: Miyabi stands on the seaside shrine's raised stone steps in her midnight-navy yukata and crimson obi, turning sideways with a small folding fan. A silver bell rests near her fox ear. The low medium view opens toward a vast golden firework above the shore. Gold and crimson bursts illuminate her amber eyes and silk patterns, while the lower steps and dark sea remain quieter beneath the glowing sky.
data.title: 星见雅 · 夏夜花火与深蓝浴衣
